title: Red Hat Security Advisory: xdg-desktop-portal security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-55888) in the xdg-desktop-portal package allows unauthorized host file access via unvalidated FileChooser filenames. The xdg-desktop-portal service exposes D-Bus interfaces used by flatpak for file access and other operations. This flaw could allow an attacker to access host files without proper authorization. Red Hat has issued a security update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.4 to address this issue.
